t: A classic Texas Instruments chip for learning embedded C in college.
steps: Buy an EK-TM4C123GXL LaunchPad from a distributor for about 20 to 28 US dollars.
Get a micro USB cable that carries data.
Install TI Code Composer Studio and the free TivaWare library.
Plug the board into the debug USB port.
Open the blinky example from TivaWare and build it.
Flash the board and watch the RGB light blink.
Try the Zephyr board guide with OpenOCD for a fully open toolchain.
meta: Open Board. From $92.99. A few stores.
